subject: blavaan do.fit argument not behaving as (I) expected

messages.subject: blavaan do.fit argument not behaving as (I) expected
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to deal with one problem in blavaan for which I want to use the do.fit argument, but it is not behaving as expected, or at least not as I expected.

There is something wrong with my data so that if I try to use bcfa I get the following error:

Error in eigen(VarCov, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE) :
  infinite or missing values in 'x'

If I am working with lavaan instead of blavaan, I don't get an error, but instead when I call summary I get the following warning:

lavaan 0.6.15 did not run (perhaps do.fit = FALSE)?
** WARNING ** Estimates below are simply the starting values

However, I am confused by how lavaan and blavaan behave differently when I try to run them on this bad data and use the do.fit argument. When I run lavaan with do.fit = FALSE, I get a fit object in my working environment. When I use blavaan with do.fit = FALSE, it appears that it's still trying to estimate the model, since I get the previous error with the eigenvalues I posted above. I do not get a fit object in my working environment. More importantly, i don't see the lavExport folder in my working directory. I just want to grab this bad data in the format in which it would be passed to Stan. How could I achieve this?

Please note that this question is not about why am I getting the error with my data or how can it be fixed. This question is about how to "force" blavaan to give me a data object even though that there is something wrong with the data. I think that should be possible, right? Since I am not asking it to perform estimation but just to reshape my data from the data frame format to the list format needed for Stan.

messages.subject: Re: blavaan do.fit argument not behaving as (I) expected
parts:
It sounds like there could be a bug. You might try adding the argument

test="none"

to the bcfa command. If that doesn't help, it would be useful to see the model syntax and bcfa command.

Ed

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: blavaan do.fit argument not behaving as (I) expected
parts:
After working on the example that you sent off-list, I just pushed a fix to github that might allow your model to run. Basically, blavaan runs lavaan for 1 iteration to initialize the model. That is why those lavaan-specific warnings show up. I made a change so that blavaan tries to keep going even if the 1-iteration lavaan run fails. Let me know if there are still problems.

There are instructions for installing from github at the bottom of this page:

https://ecmerkle.github.io/blavaan/

Ed
